lead: There are five special places in space where a spacecraft can stay in step with Earth as both go round the Sun.
try: Press L1 (Aditya-L1, SOHO) to see where India's Sun observatory sits, then L2 (James Webb).
points: At these places the pull of the Sun and Earth together keeps a spacecraft moving in step with Earth.
L1 sits between Earth and the Sun, so it can watch the Sun all the time.
L2 sits on the far side of Earth from the Sun, which helps the James Webb telescope stay cold.
